# apicp_package (Resource)

Manages an apicp resource-limit Package, assignable to a reseller or user apicp_account (PLAN.md §8 phase 1). Packages have no update API — apicp only supports create/read/delete, so changing any attribute replaces the resource. A limit left unset defaults to 0, which means 'not allowed', not 'unlimited' — there is no unlimited value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_package" "starter" {
  name     = "starter"
  for_tier = "user"

  max_web_domains  = 3
  max_databases    = 2
  max_mail_domains = 1
  max_mailboxes    = 5
  max_cron_jobs    = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `for_tier` (String) `reseller` or `user` — which account tier this package may be assigned to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `max_cron_jobs` (Number)
- `max_databases` (Number)
- `max_mail_domains` (Number)
- `max_mailboxes` (Number)
- `max_sub_accounts` (Number) Only meaningful on a for_tier="reseller" package — how many user accounts that reseller may create.
- `max_web_domains` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_account_id` (String) The account that created this package (resolved from the caller's own bearer token, not settable) — an admin's packages are usable by any account it assigns them to, a reseller's only by its own users.
